name: Bohemia
bio: Widely credited as the pioneer of Punjabi rap. His 2002 debut Vich Pardesan De laid the groundwork that a generation of desi rappers built on.

name: Yo Yo Honey Singh
bio: Hoshiarpur-born, Delhi-raised producer and rapper who turned Punjabi rap into mainstream Indian pop. International Villager reshaped the sound of 2010s party music.

name: Badshah
bio: Delhi rapper and hitmaker who started out in Mafia Mundeer and became one of Bollywood's most bankable rap voices with party records like 'DJ Waley Babu' and 'Genda Phool'.

name: Raftaar
bio: Delhi rapper of Malayali heritage who came up through Mafia Mundeer and became one of the scene's biggest crossover names. The face behind Kalamkaar and a judge on MTV Hustle.

name: KR$NA
bio: Delhi lyricist known for dense rhyme schemes and fast technical verses, and one of the most respected pens in the scene.

name: Seedhe Maut
bio: Delhi duo of Encore ABJ and Calm. Their Azadi Records debut Bayaan set a new bar for Hindi rap technique, and Nayaab became a landmark album of the 2020s.

name: Prabh Deep
bio: Tilak Nagar rapper whose debut Class-Sikh, produced by Sez on the Beat, is widely cited as one of the most important Indian hip hop albums.

name: Sez on the Beat
bio: Delhi producer behind era-defining records including 'Mere Gully Mein', Class-Sikh and Bayaan. His sound became shorthand for the Azadi-era Delhi scene.

name: DIVINE
bio: Andheri-raised rapper who became the face of Mumbai gully rap. 'Mere Gully Mein' with Naezy helped inspire the film Gully Boy, and his debut album Kohinoor launched Mass Appeal India in 2019.

name: Naezy
bio: Kurla rapper whose self-made 'Aafat!' video, famously shot on an iPad, became a DHH origin story. Performed 'Mere Gully Mein' with DIVINE.

name: Emiway Bantai
bio: One of the most subscribed independent rappers in India, built almost entirely on YouTube. Known for a relentless release pace, diss records and his own imprint, Bantai Records.

name: Swadesi
bio: Mumbai collective blending rap with Indian folk and protest traditions. 'The Warli Revolt' drew on the struggle of the Warli adivasi community.

name: MC STAN
bio: Pune rapper with an unfiltered, emotional delivery. Self-released Tadipaar in 2020 and later won Bigg Boss 16, pushing DHH into prime time television.

name: Sidhu Moose Wala
bio: Mansa-born artist who fused Punjabi folk storytelling with hip hop production and swagger, becoming one of the most streamed Punjabi artists ever. He was killed in May 2022, and posthumous releases have continued to chart.

name: Karan Aujla
bio: Songwriter turned hitmaker whose run with producer Ikky, including the album Making Memories, took Punjabi hip hop onto global charts.

name: Ikky
bio: Canada-based producer and Karan Aujla's closest collaborator, behind the full production of Making Memories.

name: AP Dhillon
bio: Gurdaspur-born, Canada-based artist whose moody, trap-leaning Punjabi records like 'Brown Munde' opened a new lane for the diaspora sound.

name: Dhanda Nyoliwala
bio: Haryanvi rapper whose viral singles pulled a new audience toward Haryanvi hip hop.

name: Hanumankind
bio: Kerala-born, Bengaluru-based rapper who spent part of his childhood in Houston. 'Big Dawgs' with producer Kalmi became a global viral hit in 2024 and put Indian rap on international charts.

name: Kalmi
bio: Producer behind the beat for 'Big Dawgs'.

name: Brodha V
bio: Bengaluru rapper from the pioneering crew Machas With Attitude, known for blending devotional themes with multilingual verses.

name: Arivu
bio: Tamil rapper and lyricist whose writing centres anti-caste politics and the stories of the land. Wrote and performed 'Enjoy Enjaami' with Dhee.

name: Dhee
bio: Singer who co-led 'Enjoy Enjaami', one of the most streamed Tamil songs of its era.

name: Santhosh Narayanan
bio: Film composer who produced 'Enjoy Enjaami' and has brought Tamil hip hop and folk forms into cinema scores.

name: Dabzee
bio: Malayalam rapper with an instantly recognisable nasal flow. 'Manavalan Thug' became a Kerala viral staple.

name: Vedan
bio: Thrissur rapper whose 'Voice of the Voiceless' became an anthem for Dalit and adivasi assertion in Malayalam rap.

name: Ahmer
bio: Kashmiri rapper whose debut Little Kid, Big Dreams documents growing up in the valley amid conflict.

name: Dhanji
bio: Amdavad rapper who chose to rap in Gujarati in a scene dominated by Hindi and Punjabi. A run of genre-bending mixtapes led to Ruab, his funk and G-funk leaning debut album, in 2023.

name: Siyaahi
bio: Ahmedabad rapper from a Kashmiri-origin family who started the Ahmedabad Hip-Hop community in 2019. Named OG Hustler on MTV Hustle 4, and followed it with the mixtape Sultanate in 2025.

name: ACHARYA
bio: Ahmedabad producer and the third name on the Amdavad Rap Life records with Dhanji and Siyaahi. Produced most of Sultanate.

name: RASLA
bio: Long-running Dhanji collaborator, credited across Drive-In Cinema, Lost in AMD and the joint album Drive-in Cinema 2.1.

name: Raga
bio: Laxmi Nagar rapper who went from underground cult hero to one of North India's biggest rap names. Debuted with Rap Ka Mausam in 2019, signed exclusively to Def Jam India, and crossed over with the Haryanvi hit 'Kaleshi Chori'.

name: vichaar
bio: Dehradun MC and designer known for rapid-fire flows and art-directed visuals. Came to national attention on MTV Hustle 4, then broke out in 2025 when '3 DRAGS' from his VVVV EP went viral.

name: Naam Sujal
bio: Jaripatka rapper and producer who blends Hindi and Marathi, and was making his own beats as a teenager. MTV Hustle 4 made him a national name, and his 2026 mixtape Mamafication came out via Def Jam India.

name: Prathamesh
bio: Nagpur rapper from the city's underground circuit, first noticed on Rohan Cariappa's One Minute Rap Challenge. Built a cult following with Naam Sujal on 'Dus Dus Peti' before Def Jam India introduced him with 'Mai Lagta Kaun?' in 2026.

name: Ikka
bio: Delhi rapper and lyricist, a childhood friend of Raftaar and Lil Golu and an original Mafia Mundeer member. A storyteller first, his albums I, Nishu and Only Love Gets Reply made him one of the most respected pens in Delhi hip hop.

name: Karan Kanchan
bio: Mumbai trap and bass producer behind some of DIVINE's biggest records, including 'Satya' and 'Baazigar', with credits for Pusha T, Vince Staples, Russ and Armani White.

name: Phenom
bio: New Delhi-born producer and rapper, one of the early names in Indian hip hop. Made 'Kaam 25' and 'Gandhi Money' for DIVINE, and brought baile funk into Indian rap on 'Mirchi'.

name: WAMP
bio: Producer behind Raga's 'GTA NCR' and a run of records for YUNG SAMMY, including 'MUDDA' with Seedhe Maut.

name: Bharg
bio: Self-taught Delhi producer and one half of Rawal & Bharg. Produced the duo's debut Sab Chahiye and appears on Ikka's Nishu.

name: Umair
bio: Karachi producer, born in 2003, working across the border with Young Stunners, Raftaar, Faris Shafi, KR$NA and Seedhe Maut. Produced 'Hola Amigo'.

name: 30KEY!
bio: Producer from the Kashmir valley and the sound behind Straight Outta Srinagar, reshaping Koshur hip hop. Signed a publishing deal with PopIndia in 2026.

name: Straight Outta Srinagar
bio: Srinagar duo of Tufail Nazir and Syed Arsalan (Aatanki), formed in 2020. Rap in Kashmiri and Hindi about life in the valley, most often over 30KEY! beats.

name: MEMAX
bio: Bantai Records producer and Emiway Bantai's go-to beatmaker on recent records like 'Those Dayz' and 'Bus Tu'.

name: Calm
bio: One half of Seedhe Maut and the duo's in-house producer. Helmed most of the beats on Lunch Break.

name: Hurricane
bio: DL91 Era producer whose genre-bending beats, full of sped-up vocal chops and Indian classical samples, drive the 30-track DL91 FM tape.
